newsitem.title: USA: Mego Financial registers 2.6 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Mego Financial registers 2.6 mln shares.

text.p: Mego Financial Corp, a financial services company, said Tuesday it had registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission 2.6 million common shares.
It said 2.0 million shares are issuable upon exercise of outstanding warrants.

One million of the warrants, with an exercise price of $4.25 each, are held or controlled by directors and officers of the company, who it said are major stockholders. The other warrants, with an exercise price of $7.125 each, are held by a financial institution and cannot be exercised until October 28, it said.

An investment fund which has been a shareholder of the company since 1993 holds the remaining 643,347 shares being registered. The terms of the sale to the investment fund required that the shares be registered, but Mego said it was advised by the fund on May 23 that the fund had no intention of selling any of the shares.
